diagram.title: TPU HBM-to-MXU dataflow and mixed-precision state budget
diagram.prediction: Which tensors stay in `float32` in HBM and which operands stream as `bfloat16` into the MXU?
diagram.reading: Follow the assumed mixed-precision ledger from HBM to compute: FP32 master weights and moments coexist with BF16 compute weights. A dot can request BF16 inputs and FP32 accumulation. A quantized path additionally needs its own scale and accumulation contract. The diagram names memory/compute boundaries; it does not show an observed kernel placement or prove an INT8 speedup.
diagram.alt: Conceptual mixed-precision ledger: HBM holds master weights and optimizer state; the compute path requires explicit operand and accumulation types, supported lowering and separately inspected target traces.

nodes.label: TPU HBM capacity: fp32 master weights + Adam (m, v) + bf16/int8 KV cache
HBM bandwidth pipe (819-2765 GB/s): stream bf16 / int8 operands
Compute path: explicit operand dtype, accumulation contract and supported lowering
Target trace: inspect compute, memory, transfer and communication evidence
